provenance: Generic aerial appearance descriptions authored without DIOR images, annotations, predictions or evaluation results. Freeze before experiments; not copied from or tuned against the test set.

classes.name: airplane
classes.description: From above, an airplane has an elongated fuselage, two lateral wings and a smaller tail. Its rigid, roughly cross-shaped silhouette may appear on a paved apron or runway.

classes.name: airport
classes.description: From above, an airport is a large paved complex with long straight runways, connecting taxiways and broad parking aprons. Terminal buildings and parked aircraft may accompany the organized layout.

classes.name: baseballfield
classes.description: From above, a baseball field has a diamond-shaped infield within a fan-shaped outfield. Contrasting dirt and grass regions and a curved outer boundary form its characteristic layout.

classes.name: basketballcourt
classes.description: From above, a basketball court is a rectangular playing surface with a center circle, straight boundary lines and painted key areas near both short ends. The markings are arranged symmetrically.

classes.name: bridge
classes.description: From above, a bridge is a narrow elongated deck spanning water or another gap. It connects routes on opposite sides and may show supporting structures or a shadow beside the deck.

classes.name: chimney
classes.description: From above, a chimney is a narrow upright tower with a small round or polygonal top, often near industrial buildings. A long thin shadow may reveal its height.

classes.name: dam
classes.description: From above, a dam is a thick straight or curved barrier across a river or valley. A broad reservoir often lies on one side, with a narrower channel or spillway on the other.

classes.name: Expressway-Service-area
classes.description: From above, an expressway service area is a group of buildings and parking lots beside a highway. Access ramps connect the complex to the road, often with open parking rows and a fuel canopy.

classes.name: Expressway-toll-station
classes.description: From above, an expressway toll station is a row of booths or a broad canopy crossing multiple parallel traffic lanes. The road widens around the aligned lanes and narrows beyond them.

classes.name: golffield
classes.description: From above, a golf course is a large irregular green landscape with elongated fairways, small rounded greens, pale sand bunkers and occasional ponds. Its grassy patches form a dispersed layout.

classes.name: groundtrackfield
classes.description: From above, a ground track field has an oval running track with parallel curved lane markings surrounding an open central field. Two straight sections connect the rounded ends.

classes.name: harbor
classes.description: From above, a harbor is a waterfront complex with docks, piers and sheltered water. Elongated ships may line the berths, with paved storage areas or buildings along the shore.

classes.name: overpass
classes.description: From above, an overpass is an elevated roadway crossing another road or railway at a different level. Crossing linear routes, approach ramps and a deck shadow distinguish the junction.

classes.name: ship
classes.description: From above, a ship has an elongated hull with a pointed or tapered bow and a wider central deck. It appears in water or beside a dock, sometimes accompanied by a wake.

classes.name: stadium
classes.description: From above, a stadium is a large oval, circular or rectangular enclosure around a central playing area. Broad spectator stands or roof sections form a substantial perimeter around the open center.

classes.name: storagetank
classes.description: From above, a storage tank usually has a circular roof and a compact cylindrical outline. Similar circles may form regular groups in an industrial site, with curved edges and short side shadows.

classes.name: tenniscourt
classes.description: From above, a tennis court is a rectangular playing surface with a central net line, inner service boxes and long parallel side lines. Several equally sized courts may appear side by side.

classes.name: trainstation
classes.description: From above, a train station has long narrow platforms beside multiple parallel railway tracks. Elongated platform roofs and larger station buildings accompany the linear rail layout.

classes.name: vehicle
classes.description: From above, a vehicle is a small compact rectangular shape with a visible roof and short elongated body. Vehicles may align with road lanes or form rows in parking areas.

classes.name: windmill
classes.description: From above, a wind turbine or windmill has a central tower with long blades extending from a hub. A narrow tower shadow and blade shadows may form an angular pattern in open terrain.
